crossRefs.note: The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the…
In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

translations.web: Pharaoh said, “Behold, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens.”
translations.bsb: Pharaoh also said, “Look, the people of the land are now numerous, and you would be stopping them from their labor.”
translations.kjv: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.
translations.asv: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land are now many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.
